title: The prognostic gene CRABP2 affects drug sensitivity by regulating docetaxel-induced apoptosis in breast invasive carcinoma: A pan-cancer analysis.
authors: Zeng, Shuangshuang; Xu, Zhijie; Liang, Qiuju; Thakur, Abhimanyu; Liu, Yuanhong; Zhou, Shangjun; Yan, Yuanliang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CRABP2基因在乳腺癌中的预后及多西他赛耐药性，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cellular retinoic acid-binding protein 2 (CRABP2), a specific transporter of retinoic acid, has been shown to have an important biological role in human cancers. However, due to the substantial variability among different tumors, the role of CRABP2 remains uncertain and has not yet been subjected to systematic analysis. Utilizing The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), Genotype-Tissue Expression (GTEx), Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium (CPTAC), Human Protein Atlas (HPA), Gene Expression Profiling Interactive Analysis 2 (GEPIA2), Kaplan-Meier Plotter, Biomarker Exploration of Solid Tumors (BEST), Cancer Cell Line Encyclopedia (CCLE), Receiver Operating Characteristic plotter (ROC plotter), and other online public tools, expression levels of CRABP2 in breast invasive carcinoma (BRCA), lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD), and ovarian serous cystadenocarcinoma (OV) were found to be significantly greater than those in adjacent normal tissues, suggesting a correlation to poor prognosis. Among the three, CRABP2 expression in BRCA was most closely associated with clinical prognosis. In a study of docetaxel-treated BRCA patients, CRABP2 expression was significantly higher in the drug-resistant group. Colony formation and flow cytometry analysis were used to further investigate the relationship between CRABP2 and docetaxel sensitivity in BRCA cells MDA-MB-231and BT549. The knockdown of CRABP2 expression significantly reduced cell growth and increased sensitivity to the chemotherapeutic agent docetaxel in BRCA cells. Furthermore, CRABP2 knockdown augmented docetaxel-induced apoptosis. Molecular docking using SwissDock tool revealed that CRABP2 had a greater binding affinity to docetaxel than docetaxel-targeted proteins. This research provides an insight into the expression and prognostic potential of CRABP2 in cancers and suggests that CRABP2 may control docetaxel sensitivity in BRCA cells through apoptosis, warranting further investigation.
abstract_zh: 细胞维甲酸结合蛋白2（CRABP2）作为维甲酸的特异性转运体，已被证实在人类癌症中具有重要的生物学作用。然而，由于不同肿瘤间存在显著异质性，CRABP2的作用仍不确定，且尚未进行系统性分析。利用癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）、基因型-组织表达数据库（GTEx）、临床蛋白质组学肿瘤分析联盟（CPAC）、人类蛋白质图谱（HPA）、基因表达谱交互分析2（GEPIA2）、Kaplan-Meier绘图器、实体肿瘤生物标志物探索（BEST）、癌细胞系百科全书（CCLE）、受试者工作特征绘图器（ROC绘图器）及其他在线公共工具，发现CRABP2在乳腺浸润癌（BRCA）、肺腺癌（LUAD）和卵巢浆液性囊腺癌（OV）中的表达水平显著高于邻近正常组织，提示其与不良预后相关。在这三种癌症中，CRABP2在BRCA中的表达与临床预后关联最为密切。在多西他赛治疗的BRCA患者研究中，耐药组中CRABP2表达显著升高。通过集落形成和流式细胞术分析，进一步研究了CRABP2与BRCA细胞MDA-MB-231和BT549对多西他赛敏感性之间的关系。敲低CRABP2表达显著降低了BRCA细胞的生长，并增加了对化疗药物多西他赛的敏感性。此外，CRABP2敲低增强了多西他赛诱导的细胞凋亡。使用SwissDock工具进行的分子对接显示，CRABP2与多西他赛的结合亲和力高于多西他赛靶向蛋白。本研究揭示了CRABP2在癌症中的表达及预后潜力，并提示CRABP2可能通过凋亡途径调控BRCA细胞对多西他赛的敏感性，值得进一步研究。
